name: Cult Adept
description: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.

abilities.name: Enervating Blast
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Shroud of the Fallen
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Shackles
abilities.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

abilities.name: Fear Is Fuel
abilities.description: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.
